title: DegreeZero property of module cohomology maps
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an $\mathcal O_Y$-module and $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\varphi:G\to h_*F$ a module morphism [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exist module isomorphisms $e_G:H^0(Y,G)\to\Gamma(Y,G)$ and $e_F:H^0(X,F)\to\Gamma(X,F)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] such that, on underlying additive groups, $\Gamma(Y,\varphi)e_G=e_F\varphi^*$, with $\varphi^*$ the degree-zero map of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] and $\Gamma(Y,h_*F)=\Gamma(X,F)$ via restriction along $h^{-1}(Y)=X$.

proof.text: Global sections is evaluation at the whole space and preserves finite limits. Use enoughInjectives on X and Y and Mathlib Functor.rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf to construct the canonical isomorphisms eG and eF, whose inverses are the canonical augmentations.

Apply ModuleCohomologyFMapData.map_zero_augmentation to the datum selected in moduleCohomologyFMap. This gives a.inv followed by the cohomology map equal to the sections map followed by b.inv, where a and b are the forgotten eG and eF. Precompose the desired equality with a.inv, use this augmentation square, and cancel b.inv followed by b.hom.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCohomologyFMap_basic_degree_zero {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y)
    {G : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf} {F : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf}
    (φ : G ⟶ (pushforward h).obj F) :
    ∃ eG : (Y.toRingedSpace.moduleCohomology 0).obj G ≅
          (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Y.toRingedSpace).obj G,
      ∃ eF : (X.toRingedSpace.moduleCohomology 0).obj F ≅
          (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj F,
        (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map eG.hom ≫
            (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map
              ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Y.toRingedSpace).map φ) =
          moduleCohomologyFMap h φ 0 ≫
            (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map eF.hom
